changeguard.same_report: Choose two different reports to compare.
changeguard.validating: Checking whether the results can be compared…
changeguard.tagline: Don't just compare numbers. Verify the comparison.

msg.UNIT_DIFFERENCE: These results use different units, so MediLens has not directly compared them.
msg.REFERENCE_RANGE_CHANGED: The reference range differs between the two reports. Direct status comparison may not be appropriate.
msg.TEST_MISMATCH: The test names are different. MediLens has not assumed they are the same test.
msg.REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: One of these values has not been verified yet, so MediLens has not compared it.
msg.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: A usable value is not available in both reports.

why.UNIT_DIFFERENCE: Medical test results should not be compared by their numerical values alone when the units differ. MediLens requires compatible reporting conditions before presenting a direct comparison.
why.REFERENCE_RANGE_CHANGED: Labs may use different methods or reference ranges. The numbers are shown, but whether each result is inside or outside its range should be read against each report's own range.
why.TEST_MISMATCH: Differently named tests may measure different things or be measured under different conditions. Confirm the match only if the reports clearly describe the same test.
why.REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: MediLens only compares values you have checked against the original report. Verify the report to include this result.
why.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The test is missing from one report, or its value is not a number, so there is nothing reliable to compare.

changeguard.confirm_match: Yes, this is the same test
changeguard.graph_note: This graph shows the change in the reported value only. It does not show whether a result is healthy or unhealthy.
changeguard.no_graph: A graph is shown only for results that can be compared.

changeguard.explain_same: Your reported {{test}} value is the same as in the previous report.
